title: Restore source authority, provenance, taxonomy, and discovery
description:
Repair the concrete source-authority, segmentation, taxonomy, and
discoverability defects, and make each class mechanically impossible to recur.

Two distinct source-authority failure modes were found and must not be conflated:
(1) unsupported non-SRD content emitted with false SRD provenance
(table:starting-wealth-by-class); (2) an editorial repair presented as if it were
supported by the rendered PDF (the Animal Friendship upcast correction).
acceptance_criteria:
- No output carries SRD provenance or CC attribution for unsupported content.
- Record boundaries follow source headings; no feature is merged into or swallowed by a sibling.
- Structured labels authored by the compiler are distinguishable from source quotation everywhere.
- The DM and deterministic tools can find canonical records without knowing the exact kind and normalized title.
notes:
Bead-writing contract (plan §VI) — this bead must state: exact scope membership
(explicit records/clauses or a deterministic query that enumerates them), root
cause, required invariant, source evidence, pack evidence, engine boundary,
regression predicate + committed assertions, generated outputs, no-repeat alias
list, and completion proof. "Fix the examples above" is not acceptable scope;
close the whole semantic class and reconcile exact membership.
